The Gordon Now App lets you place orders, browse products, and manage your account right from your
mobile device.

[Learn More >][26]

Gordon Restaurant Pro helps you control costs, plan menus, and analyze sales data to maximize
profitability.

[Learn More >][27]

[**Explore Support**][35]

## Innovative Products Inspired by People

For more than 150 years, Kimberly-Clark has been transforming insights and technologies into
innovative products and services that improve the lives of nearly a quarter of the world’s
population.

[Learn More][220]

## For a Better World

We’re committed to "Better Products, a Better Workplace, a Better Planet and a Better Society".

[Learn More][221]
[Better Desktop]

## Essentially Kimberly-Clark

With a legacy of innovation across categories, a desire to care for humanity, and a global network
of talent, we’re able to turn insights into ideas into essential products that transform lives.

[Learn More][222]

# Staples drives your business with an extensive product assortment wherever you need it.

At Staples, we’ve been providing our customers with an extensive assortment of essential office
supplies for over 35 years. From writing supplies and paper to shredders and school supplies,
Staples is the [office supply][123] expert. We are a top provider of office chairs, desks, tables &
office furniture. We also offer the latest technology—from laptops, computers & accessories, to
printers, ink & toner, and more. We have all the tools you need to stay productive and connected,
plus a wide assortment of unexpected [new & trending products][124] like luggage, smart home
technology, gaming consoles & accessories, décor, and gift cards.


[Staples has everything you could ever need for school.]

### Back to School Made Easy at Staples

For students and parents, Staples is a one-stop shop for all [school supplies][125]. Parents and
students can find everything they need to succeed, from notebooks and art materials to backpacks and
lunch boxes. Teachers will appreciate our extensive selection of classroom essentials, including
educational materials, classroom decor, organizational tools, and more. [Find your school supply
list][126] & shop for everything you need, all in one place!


[Wireless headphones are essential while traveling.]

### Staples Travel Hub

Whether your next trip is for business or pleasure, [Staples Travel Hub][127] is your new
destination for all things travel. Find luggage and travel accessories, and tech gadgets to make
your trip run smoothly. Visit us in-store to take advantage of our [TSA PreCheck][128] and passport
services.


[Prioritizing wellness throughout your day.]

### Health & Wellness

Staples range of [health & wellness products][129] can enhance your workspace and overall
well-being. Shop ergonomic furniture & tech options, as well as smart watches, candles, essential
oils & more. Our curved whiteboard has an ergonomically crafted shape to prevent strain. And a new
selection of [guided journals][130] are available, with topics including anxiety & productivity.


[Take advantage of Staples EasyRewards and AutoRestock and check another thing off your list for
good.]

### Perks of Shopping Staples

We pride ourselves on making shopping a breeze. With [Staples Easy Rewards][131], you can earn
rewards on every purchase, plus extra rewards on your chosen bonus categories. Our
[AutoRestock][132] feature ensures you never run out of essential supplies, with easy-to-manage
subscriptions. Whether you prefer to shop in-store or online, we offer flexible options for
shipping, same-day delivery, or in-store pickup.



At Staples, we are here to help you navigate your business, office, and school needs with ease.
Explore our website and discover all that Staples has to offer. We're confident you will find
exactly what you're looking for and more.

destination for all things travel. Find luggage and travel accessories, and tech gadgets to make

Staples range of [health & wellness products][129] can enhance your workspace and overall
well-being. Shop ergonomic furniture & tech options, as well as smart watches, candles, essential
oils & more. Our curved whiteboard has an ergonomically crafted shape to prevent strain. And a new
selection of [guided journals][130] are available, with topics including anxiety & productivity.


[Take advantage of Staples EasyRewards and AutoRestock and check another thing off your list for
good.]

rewards on every purchase, plus extra rewards on your chosen bonus categories. Our
[AutoRestock][132] feature ensures you never run out of essential supplies, with easy-to-manage
subscriptions. Whether you prefer to shop in-store or online, we offer flexible options for
shipping, same-day delivery, or in-store pickup.

Explore our website and discover all that Staples has to offer. We're confident you will find

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

## Advanced Biotech Provides Tissue Products that Meet the Most Stringent Regulatory Standards

### Whole Donors

Advanced Biotech’s whole donor tissue is a vital medical resource, offering unprocessed tissue from
a single donor for use in various life-enhancing treatments. It plays a critical role in surgical
procedures, wound healing, and tissue repair, ensuring biocompatibility and consistency. This
solution provides a reliable foundation for advanced care, supporting better outcomes for patients
worldwide.

### Amniotic Membrane Patches

Advanced Biotech’s amniotic membrane patches promote optimal wound healing and tissue regeneration,
leveraging their biocompatibility and natural growth factors. These patches offer a safe, effective
solution for various medical applications, adhering to strict international standards. Designed for
accessibility, they embody innovation, providing advanced care options for communities with limited
healthcare resources.

### Demineralized Bone Matrix (DBM)

Our Demineralized Bone Matrix (DBM) products are designed to support bone repair and regeneration,
utilizing their natural biocompatibility to enhance surgical outcomes. Trusted for safety and
effectiveness, these products comply with strict international standards. Accessible and innovative,
DBM solutions provide critical support to underserved markets, fostering improved recovery and
advanced patient care.

### Tissue Hardware

Advanced Biotech's Tissue Hardware products are precision-engineered for major joint and
maxillofacial surgeries, ensuring accuracy and reliability in complex procedures. Designed with a
focus on safety and compliance with international standards, these solutions enhance surgical
outcomes. Accessible and innovative, they address critical needs in underserved markets, advancing
care for diverse communities.

#### shipments, our relationships enable us to deliver unparalleled access to world-class biomedical
#### products.

### Whole Donors

Advanced Biotech’s whole donor tissue is a vital medical resource, offering unprocessed tissue from
a single donor for use in various life-enhancing treatments. It plays a critical role in surgical
procedures, wound healing, and tissue repair, ensuring biocompatibility and consistency. This
solution provides a reliable foundation for advanced care, supporting better outcomes for patients
worldwide.

### Amniotic Membrane Patches

Advanced Biotech’s amniotic membrane patches promote optimal wound healing and tissue regeneration,
leveraging their biocompatibility and natural growth factors. These patches offer a safe, effective
solution for various medical applications, adhering to strict international standards. Designed for
accessibility, they embody innovation, providing advanced care options for communities with limited
healthcare resources.

### Demineralized Bone Matrix (DBM)

Our Demineralized Bone Matrix (DBM) products are designed to support bone repair and regeneration,
utilizing their natural biocompatibility to enhance surgical outcomes. Trusted for safety and
effectiveness, these products comply with strict international standards. Accessible and innovative,

advanced patient care.

charitable causes with financial gifts on behalf of the Berk International team. These charities and

### Dedicated to moving forward.

For more than three decades, Berk International has sought to offer cutting-edge cleaning solutions.
We're proud to have received many accolades in our pursuit to create more sustainable disposable
products. For more than six years in a row, Berk International found its place on the Inc 500/5000
list. We've also climbed to the Philadelphia 100 list, and taken home the title of Best Run Company
from the Smart CEO 100. Regionally, Berk has claimed the Tri-County Chamber of Commerce Economic
Development Award. Most recently, Berk has taken the titles of the Sanitary Maintenance Distributor
Choice Award, the Philly Inquirer Family Owned Business Award, and the WOW Innovation Award in 2020.
Each day, the Berk family renews its dedication to sustainable manufacturing and creating better
products for a brighter future.

[➤ Explore Our Accolades ][77]

### Committed to giving back.

At Berk, we believe that nurturing our environment and cultivating our local communities is a
responsibility that we all share together. With the help of several organizations who support our
vision and mission for a greater tomorrow, we strive to spread health and wellness in all that we
do. In our mission to give back, we commit financially to supporting what we consider to be some of
the world's finest charities and causes.

As part of our dedication to pay it forward, Berk International is proud to provide over 39
charitable causes with financial gifts on behalf of the Berk International team. These charities and
causes include the American Cancer Society, Big Brothers Big Sisters, Make-A-Wish, and The Smile
Train. With every contribution, we're reminded how important it is to support the communities that
make Berk's success possible.

[➤ See Our Charitable Gifts ][78]

## LEARN MORE ABOUT CARDINAL TISSUE

**Founded in 2018 by Vince Reese, Cardinal Tissue has quickly become a leader in the tissue
manufacturing industry. While currently headquartered in Spindale, North Carolina, our company has
continued to aggressively expand its operations within the Southeastern United States by adding
these additional locations:**


* **Rutherfordton, North Carolina (Warehousing and Distribution)**
* **Rock Hill, South Carolina (Manufacturing)**
* **Palatka, Florida (Manufacturing)**



**The Rock Hill and Palatka facilities are a result of Cardinal Tissue’s acquisition of Softex
Paper’s US assets in 2025, which marks a significant milestone in the company’s growth plan and
commitment to enhancing its customer offerings.  **



**Cardinal Tissue's Current Capabilities:**


* **Four locations that represent a combined total of over 1,000,000 million square feet under
  roof.**
* **Contract tissue manufacturer that provides best in class tissue suppliers with solutions for
  contract converting and supply chain optimization. **
* **Unique expertise in augmenting supplier production needs for all categories and tiers of retail
  tissue products, such as toilet paper, paper towels, napkins, and facial tissue.**
* **Provider of training and technical support for converting optimization, new construction
  modernization of equipment, as well as contract tolling agreements. **

**Do you want to know why toilet paper demand spiked 845% during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020? It
wasn't just hoarders who were to blame for the shortage during that time. Cardinal Tissue CEO, Vince
Reese, was interviewed by Business Insider, and in this video he explains why this shortage occurred
and how Cardinal Tissue worked creatively to keep up with the increased demand.  **

## About Data Insights Market

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

## Dropship products

Every tool you need to cover product research, ad spying, sales tracking, and competitor analysis,
all in one account.

Sales Tracker
Portfolio
Shop Library
Ad Library
Product Library
Advertiser Tracker
Competitor Research
Advertiser Library
Magic AI Search
Creator Library

### Sales Tracker

Add TikTok shops and products to Sales Tracker to effectively track sales. Ensuring you spot the
next big opportunity before others.

[
View product
][32]

No more guesswork

Review sales and revenue from millions of products and shops to make data-driven decisions.

Daily and historical metrics

Every tracked item shows sales today, yesterday, 7 days, 30 days, and total revenue.

Handsfree

All you need to do is add a Tiktok shop or product listing to Sales Tracker, and we'll handle the
rest.

### Portfolio

You are only one product away from taking your dropshipping journey to the next level, let us do
your product research.

[
View product
][33]

Save time & money

Remain informed about any product trends, market shifts, or potential opportunities that might help
scale your business.

Handsfree

Receive product drops on a weekly basis, delivered straight to your Dropship portfolio.

One sale, bill paid

Roughly one sale is all you need to cover the cost of a subscription with us. On the other hand, one
winner could do wonders.

### Shop Library

Search every TikTok Shop by revenue, sales, growth rate, and niche. Find market leaders and the high
performing shops.

[
View product
][34]

Filter by revenue and sales

Filter shops by revenue, sales volume, and product prices to match your exact requirements.

Growth rate filter

Filter by growth rate to find the shops catching on right now, not just the biggest ones.

Track historical revenue

Click any shop's arrow to open an average daily revenue chart and study long term patterns.

### Ad Library

HOT

See exactly how much your competitors spend on every ad. Sort by spend, spot the biggest budgets,
and find winning products before they go mainstream.

[
View product
][35]

See ad spend in dollars

Every ad shows total spend in USD, not campaign totals or adset totals.

Advertiser insights per ad

The three-dot menu opens Advertiser insights, similar ads, and the underlying Facebook Ad Library
page.

Search by keyword or image

Run a keyword search, upload a product photo, or both. The system matches text and visuals.

### Product Library

View what products a TikTok Shop is selling and how much revenue they are making in real-time with
our Product Library.

[
View product
][36]

Filter by real TikTok sales

Set min and max for price, sales, revenue, images, and variants to find products that match your
exact criteria.

**Shop level analytics**

Click a shop name to open total revenue, total sales, and unique products sold for any period.

Track products in one click

Hit the heart icon on any product to send it to Sales Tracker for daily monitoring.

Advertiser Tracker

TRENDING

Track any Facebook advertiser and see their new ads the moment they launch. Organize them in
Collections by niche or campaign type.

[
View product
][37]

Paste a Meta Ad Library link

One URL is all we need. Paste a Meta Ad Library link and the advertiser lands in your tracker.

Track from any tool

Add advertisers from Advertiser Library, Ad Library results, or Magic AI Search, all in one click.

Organize in Collections

Group tracked advertisers by niche, scale, or campaign type in your own collections.

### Competitor Research

Make laser-targeted searches on millions of product listings to find out which stores sell the
products you're researching.

[
View product
][38]

Market research

Find out whether the market for your desired product is untapped or too competitive for you to
enter.

Optimize to conquer

Take advantage of the insights to optimize your offer and marketing strategy and beat your
competitors.

Analyze the competition

Identify your competitors, evaluate their strengths and weaknesses, and how they compare to your
business.

### Advertiser Library

Advertiser Library indexes brands running Facebook ads by EU ad spend, reach, and follower count.
Filter by niche, country, and launch date to find the ones worth learning from.

[
View product
][39]

Filter by EU ad spend

Set minimum and maximum spend to find advertisers at your scale, or at the scale you want to reach.

Category-level targeting

Pick your niche from Categories to see only advertisers in your exact industry.

Track any advertiser

Hit the track button from any result to start logging their new ads in Advertiser Tracker.

### Magic AI Search

Upload any image, video, or link and Magic AI Search finds matching products and ads across
Dropship's full database.

[
View product
][40]

Find lookalikes instantly

See similar products, similar ads, and similar stores built around the same idea, all from a single
search.

Validate before you commit

Check demand, competition, and ad activity for any product idea before you add it to your store.

Always fresh results

Our database updates constantly, so every search reflects what's working right now, not last month.

### Creator Library

NEW

Search over 350,000 of TikTok creators by sales, revenue, top videos, and niche. Find the ones
driving real revenue, not just views.

[
View product
][41]

Spot the sellers

Every video ranked by dollars, not likes. See which creators turn views into real shop sales.

Full creator details

Open any creator for a full history. Sales, revenue, videos, linked shops, products, and activity
status.

Every video, measured

Every video comes with sales, revenue, and engagement data so you know what converts.

## Millions of products

Search millions of TikTok Shop products with live sales and revenue. Filter by price, reviews, and
category to find winners.

[
Learn More
][42]

## Track Stores Revenue

Paste any TikTok Shop link and watch daily sales, revenue, and growth rate show up within 24 hours.

[
Learn More
][43]

Find your next profitable product by exploring our vast database with millions of products and ads,
using our smart search.

Learn More

and communities.

Whether we're making the retail store brands you know and love, or our own brands, our everyday
essentials are innovative, high-quality and affordable. We're there every step of the way with our
retail and healthcare partners to deliver products and programs built to improve lives. From
absorbent hygiene and premium household products to our durable and vibrant flexible packaging, we
continuously strive to make things better—for our consumers, our team members and our planet.

# First Quality^{®}

A leading manufacturer of everyday essentials for personal and household care, we’re a family-owned
business founded in 1989. Every day, we strive to make things better for our team members, customers
and communities.

Scroll to learn more

## Make Things Better^{®}

[WATCH: Our Purpose Video][20]
[Family]
 
 
 

# Products Are Only the Beginning

Whether we're making the retail store brands you know and love, or our own brands, our everyday
essentials are innovative, high-quality and affordable. We're there every step of the way with our
retail and healthcare partners to deliver products and programs built to improve lives. From
absorbent hygiene and premium household products to our durable and vibrant flexible packaging, we
continuously strive to make things better—for our consumers, our team members and our planet.

[Learn More][21]

### Improving Lives with Innovative Solutions

#### First Quality believes in making things better one essential product at a time. From our
#### premium detergents and packaging solutions to our super-absorbent paper towels and baby
#### diapers, each of our four divisions focuses on producing top-of-the-line products at an
#### affordable cost. 

[Absorbent Hygiene Division]

[Learn More][22]
[Tissue Division]

[Learn More][23]
[Home Care Division]
 
Home Care

[Learn More][24]
 
Print & Packaging
Innovative flexible packaging solutions and exceptional print quality
[Learn More][25]

essentials to help improve every stage of life.

#### Genewin Biotech Corporate Video

**Genewin Biotech** has carved a niche amongst the most trusted names in the market and incorporated
in the year **2006** as a **Partnership** based firm. The head quarter of our corporation is
situated at **Hosur,** **Tamil Nadu.** We are dedicatedly engaged in **producing** and **exporting
many varieties of plants though tissue culture techniques.**  These products are highly preferred
for their impeccable quality. We also provide **Testing Service, and Analysis Service**. We export
our 80% product in **USA, Malaysia, Africa, Singapore, Thailand, Nepal and Bangladesh.**

#### Bambusa Nutans - Bamboo Tissue Cultured Plant

**LOCAL NAMES:**
Mokal/Mallo/Kali (Arunachal Pradesh); Deobanh/Jatie makal (Assam); Utang (Manipur); Mal Bans
(Sikkim); Rungazumi (Nagaland).

**USES:  **
It is used for house construction, paper, agarbatti, mat and poles.

**CHARACTERISTICS**: 

1.  Culm length upto 15 m 

2.  Culm diameter :  5 -10 cms

3.  Internode length :  25 - 45 m

4.  Wall thickness : long and thick walled

[Learn more][109]

#### Dendrocalamus Asper - Bamboo Tissue Cultured Plant

**LOCAL NAMES:**
Sweet Bamboo, Rough Bamboo.

**USES:**  
Known for its high quality edible shoots. Poles are strong which is very much useful in the
construction.  

**CHARACTERISTICS**: 

1.  Culm length  up to 30 m

2.  Culm diameter upto  20 cm 

3.  Internode length upto  40 cm 

4.  Wall thickness – Hollow culms with thick wall especially at the base.

[Learn more][110]

#### Yellow Turmeric - Tissue Cultured Plant

Planting Distance - 1.5 x 1.5 Feet

Plants required / Acre - 15000 to 20000 Plants

Crop Durations - 7 to 9 Months

Expected Yield / Plant - 700 to 1300 Grams 

#### Ginger Varadha - Tissue Cultured Plant

Areas of Adoption - All over India.  

Maturity - 180 - 200 days  

Average Yield - 22.6 t/ha  

Quality Attribute:  

Essential oil 1.75%.  Dry recovery 20.7%.  Fibre content 3.29-4.5% 

Morphological Characters :
Colour of aerial shoot - Green Plant height (cm) - 72.32.  Leaf length/breadth (cm) - 28.3/2.5.  No.
of tillers per clump - 9.4  No. of leaves per tiller - 20  Colour of rhizome core - blusish yellow
 Shape of rhizome -  plumpy with flattened fingers.  Colour of scale - Reddish brown 

[Learn more][111]

#### Syngoniums - Tissue Cultured Plant

Uses : Ornamental and Gardening

Character : Creeper

Growth Area : Indoor and Outdoor

## Kruger Products is one of North America’s leading manufacturer of quality tissue paper products.

######  

###### With approximately 3,000 employees across 10 manufacturing plants in North America, we are
###### proud to make everyday life more comfortable for the communities we serve.

**WHAT WE DO**

## Making everyday life more comfortable

Great things can happen when people work passionately towards a common goal. That’s how Kruger
Products grew to become North America's leading manufacturer of quality tissue products for
household, industrial, and commercial use. We are proud to offer a portfolio of quality tissue
products for every room in your home.

[What We Do][52]

[what we do]

**WHO WE ARE**

## Kruger Products at a glance

We are proud that our core brands are made in Canada, by Canadians for Canadians. Everywhere we
operate, we invest in our communities and the environment through sustainability initiatives and
local philanthropy.

[product]

Canada’s largest portfolio of #1 consumer tissue brands

[personel]

[award]

Ranked a GTA Top Employer annually since 2013

[manufacturer]

Ranked a top CPG supplier by Canadian retailers since 2010

[sustainability]

Nationally recognized as an industry leader in sustainability

[cancer]

Top 5 partner supporting the breast cancer cause at Canadian Cancer Society

[north america]

**OUR LOCATIONS**

## We operate across North America

Our locations are strategically aligned to the natural resources we use to make our products, and to
key population centres that represent 90% of Canadian and 60% of U.S. consumers.

With 10 manufacturing plants, our total papermaking capacity is just over one-third of Canada’s
total tissue manufacturing capacity. We are also proud to be the only tissue products company with
manufacturing operations in Western Canada.

[View our locations][53]

[Sustainability]
[Reimagine 2030]

## Reimagine 2030: Transformable Growth. Sustainable Innovation.

Our sustainability mission prioritizes the environment and our social impact to make everyday life
more comfortable. In 2020, we thought about where we wanted to be in 10 years, and where we hope the
world can be. This is the inspiration behind Reimagine 2030, a decade of transformative growth and
sustainable innovation.

[See How We Are Reimagining 2030][54]

**CAREERS**

## Make your career something great with Kruger Products

We are focused on building a culture and environment that appreciates and values the strength that
differences bring – we see greatness in each and every one of our people. We bring this to life
through best-in-class programs, practices, and processes so our people can learn, grow, and achieve
their personal and career aspirations.

[Learn more about working with us][55]

## About Us

Established in 2001, Ultracare is the region’s leading manufacturer of hygiene tissue paper
products. Boasting a 36,000 square feet facility located in Dubai Investment Park, it is renowned
amongst its peers for its high capacity and production flexibility; hence making Ultracare one of
the leading **tissue manufacturers in UAE**.

Manufacturing the complete range of tissue paper products for both the retail and institutional
segments, Ultracare is proud to be the preferred choice for private label manufacturing. In addition
to manufacturing tissue paper products, Ultracare gives additional value to its clients through the
extensive range of tissue paper dispensers, personal protective equipment (PPE) disposables,
catering disposables and [cleaning products][61].

At Ultracare, we believe in creating an innovative future through proper paper usage and
manufacturing focusing on sustainability. We strive to deliver value to our customers with
high-quality tissue paper and exceptional service to the highest standards. Our state-of-the-art
facility is fitted out with cutting-edge machinery and we only procure raw materials from FSC
Certified Mills. We are also a leading tissue paper distributor in Kuwait, Oman, Qatar and the
Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Established in 2001, Ultracare is the region’s leading manufacturer of hygiene tissue paper
products. Boasting a 36,000 square feet facility located in Dubai Investment Park, it is renowned
amongst its peers for its high capacity and production flexibility; hence making Ultracare one of
the leading **tissue manufacturers in UAE**.

Manufacturing the complete range of tissue paper products for both the retail and institutional
segments, Ultracare is proud to be the preferred choice for private label manufacturing. In addition
to manufacturing tissue paper products, Ultracare gives additional value to its clients through the
extensive range of tissue paper dispensers, personal protective equipment (PPE) disposables,
catering disposables and [cleaning products][61].

At Ultracare, we believe in creating an innovative future through proper paper usage and
manufacturing focusing on sustainability. We strive to deliver value to our customers with
high-quality tissue paper and exceptional service to the highest standards. Our state-of-the-art
facility is fitted out with cutting-edge machinery and we only procure raw materials from FSC
Certified Mills. We are also a leading tissue paper distributor in Kuwait, Oman, Qatar and the
Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

#### While expanding a current business or while venturing into new business, entrepreneurs are
#### often faced with the dilemma of zeroing in on a suitable product/line.

The report provides an expansive market analysis by covering areas like: growth drivers, trends
prevailing in the industry, Demand-Supply Situation, Foreign Trade, Porters 5 Forces Analysis,
regulatory framework as well as comprehensive SWOT analysis of the sector.

The report further establishes the regulatory framework of the industry. It encapsulates the status
of the current legislation in the industry as well as the recent changes and developments in the
regulations. The report also provides key player profiles along with key financials and comparison.
The market research report shares vital information like shareholding pattern, revenue mix, plant
location and financial summary of the key companies.

[Learn More ][82]

#### Industrial Development Technologies & Project Opportunities

Entrepreneur India,  a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) is
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the suitable project for investment. It makes business
decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a list of right projects for investment. Unique among
project investment magazines, 'Entrepreneur India' is dedicated to the business of identifying sound
investment projects. Every issue consists of a new list of projects which are meticulously selected
by the Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team after being screened on various investment
factors. Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team, before labeling a project as 'Right
investment' studies various aspects of investment like product demand, market potential, raw
material availability, suitable location, payback period, costs involved and breakeven point.

(Instant Online Project Identification and Selection)

(Instant Online Project Identification and Selection)

Finding the right startup business is one of the most popular subject today. Starting a business is
no easy endeavour, but the time, effort, and challenges can be worth it if you succeed. To give
yourself the best chance to be successful, take your time to carefully find the right business for
you.

We, at Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS), endeavour to make business selection a simple and
convenient step for any entrepreneur/startup. Our expert team, by capitalizing on its dexterity and
decade's long experience in the field, has created a list of profitable ventures for entrepreneurs
who wish to diversify or venture. The list so mentioned is updated regularly to give you a regular
dose of new emerging opportunities.

#### Bankable Project Reports & Feasibility Study Services

Get professionally crafted, bankable project reports tailored to your business needs. Each report
includes detailed market analysis, techno-economic feasibility, manufacturing process, machinery
planning, investment estimates, and regulatory insights which is ideal for start-ups, entrepreneurs,
and expanding industries. Our DPRs (Detailed Project Reports) are research-driven,
implementation-ready, and suitable for bank loans, investor approvals, and business planning.
Make confident decisions with accurate, practical, and industry-focused documentation designed to
support successful project execution.

[Learn More ][81]
[Project Reports Illustration]

#### While expanding a current business or while venturing into new business, entrepreneurs are
#### often faced with the dilemma of zeroing in on a suitable product/line.

The report provides an expansive market analysis by covering areas like: growth drivers, trends
prevailing in the industry, Demand-Supply Situation, Foreign Trade, Porters 5 Forces Analysis,
regulatory framework as well as comprehensive SWOT analysis of the sector.

The report further establishes the regulatory framework of the industry. It encapsulates the status
of the current legislation in the industry as well as the recent changes and developments in the
regulations. The report also provides key player profiles along with key financials and comparison.
The market research report shares vital information like shareholding pattern, revenue mix, plant
location and financial summary of the key companies.

[Learn More ][82]
[Market Research Illustration]

#### Industrial Development Technologies & Project Opportunities

Entrepreneur India,  a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) is
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the suitable project for investment. It makes business
decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a list of right projects for investment. Unique among
project investment magazines, 'Entrepreneur India' is dedicated to the business of identifying sound
investment projects. Every issue consists of a new list of projects which are meticulously selected
by the Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team after being screened on various investment
factors. Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team, before labeling a project as 'Right
investment' studies various aspects of investment like product demand, market potential, raw
material availability, suitable location, payback period, costs involved and breakeven point.

[Learn More ][83]
[Entrepreneur India Illustration]

#### Select and Choose the Right Business Startup for You

(Instant Online Project Identification and Selection)

(Instant Online Project Identification and Selection)

Finding the right startup business is one of the most popular subject today. Starting a business is
no easy endeavour, but the time, effort, and challenges can be worth it if you succeed. To give
yourself the best chance to be successful, take your time to carefully find the right business for
you.

We, at Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS), endeavour to make business selection a simple and
convenient step for any entrepreneur/startup. Our expert team, by capitalizing on its dexterity and
decade's long experience in the field, has created a list of profitable ventures for entrepreneurs
who wish to diversify or venture. The list so mentioned is updated regularly to give you a regular
dose of new emerging opportunities.

[Learn More ][84]
[Startup Selector Illustration]

## What We Offer

We help our clients meet challenges and seize opportunities successfully by providing a
comprehensive suite of expert services.

Project Introduction, Brief History of the Product, Properties, BIS (Bureau of Indian Standard)

Formulae Detailed Process of Manufacture, Flow Sheet Diagram.

[Market Survey]

#### Market Survey

Present Market Position, Expected Future Demand, Statistics of Imports & Exports, Export Prospect,
Names and Addresses of Existing Units (Present Manufactures).

[Personnel Requirement]

#### Personnel Requirement

Requirement of Staff & Labour, Personnel Management, Skilled & Unskilled Labour.

[Plant & Machinery]

#### Plant & Machinery

List of Plant & Machineries, Miscellaneous Items and Accessories, Instruments, Laboratory
Equipment's and Accessories, Plant Location, Electrification, Electric Load and Water, Maintenance,
Suppliers / Manufacturers of Plant and Machineries.

[Land & Building]

#### Land & Building

Requirement of Land Area, Rates of the Land, Built up Area, Construction Schedule, Plant Layout.

[Raw Material]

#### Raw Material

List of Raw Materials, Properties of Raw Materials, Availability of Raw Materials, Required Quality
of Raw Materials, Cost / Rates of Raw Materials.

[Financial Aspects]

#### Financial Aspects

Cost of Raw Materials, Cost of Land & Building, Cost of Plant & Machineries, Fixed Capital
Investment, Working Capital, Project Cost, Capital Formation, Cost of Production, Profitability
Analysis, Break Even Point, Cash Flow Statement for 5 to 10 Years, Depreciation Chart, Conclusion,
Projected Balance Sheet, Land Man Ratio.

[Entrepreneur India (An Industrial Monthly Journal)]

Entrepreneur India is a monthly industrial magazine focused on development, technologies, and
project opportunities. It simplifies investment decisions for business leaders, young entrepreneurs,
women entrepreneurs, investors, NRIs, startups, and professionals, providing crucial information on
viable projects. It's the ideal resource for identifying sound investment opportunities.

## Tredje robotrevolutionens industrirobot

# Flexibla mobila

# robotlösningar

### Nästa steg efter traditionella och kollaborativa robotlösningar

*Flexibel  mobil robot – Snabb och enkel programmering – Säkerhet utan staket*

OpiFlex erbjuder marknadsledande, flexibla och mobila robotlösningar som effektivt automatiserar
produktion med hög produktvariation och låg volym inom olika industrier. Efterfrågad av både
små-medelstora företag samt stora globala koncerner som ser det kraftigt ökade behovet av
**flexibilitet** och för att skapa **flexibla** och **framtidssäkra lösningar**.

OpiFlex prisade lösningar **leder** den **tredje robotrevolutionen ”Flexibla mobila robotar”. Vi gör
ABB robotar flexibla och är en certifierad global partner med ABB.**

**#OpiFlex** är **mer** **än** en **traditionell #robot **eller **#cobot**, #OpiFlex är en
**#*flexbot***. #***Marknadsledare i #flexiblerobots #beyondcobots***

[Läs mer om tillämpningar][37]
1

## Flexibel & kostnadseffektiv

Helt nya automationsmöjligheter. Flytta industriroboten till annan maskin för produktivitetsökning
eller manuell access. Du kan tjäna in roboten på under ett år.

### 10x

## Snabbare integration

Än en traditionell industrirobot. Tack vare vår standardiserade lösningar, enkel programmering samt
vår dockningsplattform.

### 50x

## Snabbare programmering

Enkel, där ingen tidigare erfarenhet krävs. Vem som helst gör det på 1-5 minuter istället för 4-5
timmar med en specialist.



## Slipp staket vid hög hastighet och last

Kör säkert utan staket med hög hastighet och hög last. OpiFlex patenterade säkerhetslösning utan
staket uppfyller EN ISO 10218-2.  

.

## Tillämpningar

### Flexibla mobila robotlösningar – klarar dina nutida och framtida behov

### Små serier – hög mix och låg volym

Med vår användarvänliga lösning kan du programmera robotar på 1-5 minuter, 50 gånger snabbare, än
traditionella metoder, utan behov av tidigare erfarenhet. Dessutom möjliggörs fullständig manuell
åtkomst till maskinerna. 

### Hög volym och högtillgänglighet vid 24/7

Standardiserad hårdvara för framtidssäker användning och enkelt underhåll. Byt snabbt ut
industrirobotar för underhåll eller reparation. Klara höga krav på tillgänglighet vid 24/7 . Snabb
och enkel ändring av layout. 

### Låg och ojämn maskinanvändning

Dela robotcell med flera maskiner, öka utnyttjande och förbättra pay-off. Utnyttja ökade
produktiviteten som fås av en flexibel industrirobot, något som är svårt med en fast robot.

### Flexibel konfiguration av linjor och kringutrustning

Skapa väldigt flexibla linor med olika robotkonfigurationer baserat på dina behov för tillfället.
Skala gradvis upp eller ner produktionen och mixa produkter som du vill.

## Tillämpningar

### För alla olika industrier

^

#### Små-medelstora företag



#### Underleverantör



#### Globala Koncerner & OEM

### Plåt • Bearbetning • Trä & Möbler • Plast • Automotive • Livsmedel • Annat

### Maskinbetjäning • Materialhantering • Palletering • Montering

## Fördelar med OpiFlex flexibla robotlösningar och industrirobot

### Utöver en traditionell robotlösning får du



#### Enkel programmering

Programmera på 10 minuter utan förkunskaper. Kompatibel med RAPID-program



#### Dela robot med flera maskiner

Flytta enkelt robotcellen och dela andra maskiner för ökat utnyttjande och flexibilitet. Dockning
ger samma prestanda som fast robot



#### Säkerhet utan staket

För hög last och hög hastighet. Full prestanda. Följer alltid alla EU: maskindirektiv 2006/42 / EG



#### Full manuell access

Flytta enkelt industriroboten när du behöver komma åt maskinen manuellt.



#### Standardiserad hårdvara

Fabrikstillverkad lösning ger robusthet och enkelt underhåll. Komponenter från stora företag som ABB
och SICK.

## Snabbare integration

nära. Säkert och flexibelt. Till skillnad från kollaborativa robotar är det alltid staketfritt.

och vidare. Systemet övervakar en story yta kring robotcellen och saktar ner när människor är för
nära. Säkert och flexibelt. Till skillnad från kollaborativa robotar är det alltid staketfritt.

OpiFlex vann **EU kommissionens stora innovations pris 2015, **Under **2016** blev, som en av
tre, **finalist av IERA Award**, **det mest prestigefyllda robot- och automationspriset i världen
**samt vald till **Pioneers 500, **de **femhundra hetaste tech start-up i världen**.** **Under
**2018** blev OpiFlex vinnare och kom med i **"33-listan", Sveriges mest prestigefyllda lista för
unga tech-bolag**. Detta delas ut av tidningen NyTeknik och affärstidningen Affärsvärlden. Tidigare
på listan har företag som Spotify, Mojang, Truecaller, Klarna and iZettle varit med. **2019** erhöll

## Pay-off < 1 år

OpiFlex flexibla mobila robotceller och robotlösningar är kostnadseffektiva, vilket ger en normal
pay-off på mindre än ett år för en industrirobot från OpiFlex. Redan vid första cellen är det samma
prisnivå som en traditionell fast robotcell med staket, men vid nästa cell är OpiFlex robotcell
mycket billigare eftersom roboten delas med flera robotceller.

Med en mobil robot, skapar du en framtidssäker robotlösning, så kan du enkelt bygga vidare på din
investering direkt eller längre fram.

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

View details

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists who met at the European Organization for Nuclear Research
(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and
we work for the public good.

[Read our story
][185]

## Built by the community, for the community

View details

Proton is a community-first organization, created through a public crowdfunding campaign and built
with community input. Our only source of revenue is subscriptions from users.

We exist only to serve you, not advertisers or other third parties. By choosing Proton, you join a
movement of millions of volunteers, contributors, and users creating an internet that puts people
first.

[Join our community
][186]

# Tissue Products

# Our Mission: Making everyday life more comfortable

Through equal parts innovation and dedication, Kruger Products has become Canada's leading
manufacturer of tissue products for household, industrial and commercial use.

[Beware of Fraudulent Job Offers][42]

## About Us

With the support of 2,700 employees and the advantage of nine manufacturing plants across North
America, we are dedicated to creating, developing and offering high quality tissue products for
every day use.

[Learn more about us ][43]

## Community Involvement

Kruger Products cares about the greater community. From the very beginning, we’ve invested in the
communities where we operate through local philanthropy, and in the environment through
sustainability initiatives. It’s in our DNA.

[Learn more][44]

## Contact us

If you have questions or need information on one of our tissue products, feel free to reach out. We
look forward to hearing from you.

[Contact us][45]

# What we make

## We manufacture Canada’s
## most popular tissue brands

Kruger Products is the country’s leading manufacturer of quality tissue products for household,
industrial, and commercial use. We are proud to offer a portfolio of Canada’s favorite tissue brands
for every room in your home.

[Browse Our Products][46]

# Discover Our Production Sites

Reset Filters

[Discover Our Sites][47]

## We’re here for you

Have questions? We’re always ready to help.

[Meet our team ][48]

## Supplier Zone

Whether you are currently doing business with us or interested in becoming one of our suppliers,
visit our Supplier Zone to learn more about our procurement procedures.

[Kruger Supplier Zone][49]

## Career

If you value commitment, integrity, customer satisfaction, the well-being of our communities and the
protection of our resources, join Kruger and help us make sustainable products that touch millions
of people every day.

[Find a position][50]

# Leading Innovation in Tissue Processing

Pioneering advanced research and manufacturing of human cellular and tissue-based products.

[ About Us ][30]

# Our Commitments

## Excellence

Excellence is at the core of our mission, driving us to consistently deliver high-quality allograft
products that meet the diverse needs of healthcare providers. We achieve this through continual
improvement, rigorous training, and a commitment to adopting innovative practices that enhance our
services and patient outcomes.

## Integrity

Integrity is the cornerstone of our operations, guiding every decision we make to ensure
transparency and trustworthiness in our practices. We are dedicated to upholding ethical standards
in allograft sourcing, processing, and distribution, fostering confidence among our partners and the
communities we serve.

## Partnership

Partnership is fundamental to our success, as we collaborate closely with healthcare providers,
researchers, and other stakeholders to advance regenerative medicine. By fostering strong,
transparent relationships, we ensure that our combined expertise leads to the development of
high-quality allograft products that meet the evolving needs of patients and the healthcare
industry.

## Vision

Our vision is to be a leader in the tissue banking industry, transforming regenerative medicine
through innovative solutions and unparalleled service. We aspire to create a future where every
patient has access to high-quality allografts that enhance healing and improve lives, while
fostering strong partnerships within the medical community.

# Our Products

Our allograft products represent the pinnacle of innovation in tissue banking, designed to meet the
diverse needs of surgical and clinical applications. With a focus on enhancing healing outcomes, we
utilize cutting-edge processing technologies and stringent quality controls to ensure each allograft
retains its biological integrity and efficacy. Our commitment to continuous improvement drives us to
explore new methods and materials, allowing us to introduce advanced allograft solutions that align
with the latest medical research and practices. By prioritizing collaboration with healthcare
professionals, we stay attuned to emerging needs and trends, enabling us to refine our products and
push the boundaries of what is possible in regenerative medicine.

## A One-Stop Shop For All Your Company Data Needs!
* COMPANY DATA
* AI
* B2B
* API
* REPORT

TradeAtlas’ global database provides the most up-to-date information about overseas importers and
exporters for companies aiming to make trade connections in international markets and monitor their
customers & competitors. The importers’ and exporters’ data on TradeAtlas is obtained from bill of
lading data and customs records. Therefore, all the information on the database comes from actual
and realized transactions.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][41]

With the Potential Importers solution, you can discover the companies that have not imported a
product or product group in the target market you have selected but have a very high potential to
import in a matter of seconds with nearly 100% accuracy. We provide the most suitable importer and
supplier companies for your export among millions of real companies via “Top-Matching Importers
Module” which is listed by evaluating many parameters such as import volumes, past import
transactions, geographical distance, import frequencies, interest levels and trade sizes.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][42]

TradeAtlas works closely with producers to promote their products internationally. We offer a
state-of-art marketing strategy powered by our own company-level data, which includes 20+ million
importers all over the world from 230 countries/territories, from USA to Papua New Guinea, from
Madagascar to Chile, from Yemen to the UK. We contact, negotiate and close sales for your products
on behalf of your company with our experienced team and dealers all over the world. Please contact
us for more details, including your products and website for a preliminary analysis.

[CONTACT US >>][43]

TradeAtlas features can be used through our simple REST API. Integrate with TradeAtlas API to
automatize your work with company-level international trade data. TradeAtlas API does 2 main jobs:
count feature (you can count how many Italian exporters are there who exports furniture to the USA)
and download feature (you can download all details of the Italian exporters who exports furniture to
the USA, including importer and exporter company names, prices, quantities, products, HS codes,
ports, and more, whichever available in our database). Please feel free to contact us for more
details, pricing, technical documents and a free trial.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][44]

TradeAtlas’ unique coverage of company-level international trade data, consists of 2+ billion lines
of transactions, could also be ordered via reporting feature (offline Excel/CSV files). Please
describe your need for trade route (for ex; I need shipments arriving to African continent from
EU-27 zone / or / all shipments leaving Chile to the world), product (for ex; I need all drug
shipments / or / I need all shipments under Chapter 70: Glass and glassware) and the period for the
shipments (during the last 12 months / or / from 2020 till the latest available data). Please feel
free to contact us for more details, pricing, shipments/company count and a sample file.

[CONTACT US >>][45]

supplier companies for your export among millions of real companies via “Top-Matching Importers
Module” which is listed by evaluating many parameters such as import volumes, past import
transactions, geographical distance, import frequencies, interest levels and trade sizes.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][42]

TradeAtlas works closely with producers to promote their products internationally. We offer a
state-of-art marketing strategy powered by our own company-level data, which includes 20+ million
importers all over the world from 230 countries/territories, from USA to Papua New Guinea, from
Madagascar to Chile, from Yemen to the UK. We contact, negotiate and close sales for your products
on behalf of your company with our experienced team and dealers all over the world. Please contact
us for more details, including your products and website for a preliminary analysis.

[CONTACT US >>][43]

TradeAtlas features can be used through our simple REST API. Integrate with TradeAtlas API to
automatize your work with company-level international trade data. TradeAtlas API does 2 main jobs:
count feature (you can count how many Italian exporters are there who exports furniture to the USA)
and download feature (you can download all details of the Italian exporters who exports furniture to
the USA, including importer and exporter company names, prices, quantities, products, HS codes,
ports, and more, whichever available in our database). Please feel free to contact us for more
details, pricing, technical documents and a free trial.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][44]

TradeAtlas’ unique coverage of company-level international trade data, consists of 2+ billion lines
of transactions, could also be ordered via reporting feature (offline Excel/CSV files). Please
describe your need for trade route (for ex; I need shipments arriving to African continent from
EU-27 zone / or / all shipments leaving Chile to the world), product (for ex; I need all drug
shipments / or / I need all shipments under Chapter 70: Glass and glassware) and the period for the
shipments (during the last 12 months / or / from 2020 till the latest available data). Please feel
free to contact us for more details, pricing, shipments/company count and a sample file.
